ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; over 95% of the visible ventral surface consists of low-intensity black pixels, with high-intensity white/brown pixels restricted to localized distal tips and transient water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the visible surface area; high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs are mapped exclusively to the distal-most tips of both lobes (white and brown clusters).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a shallow pixel depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; the left lobe displays higher amplitude peaks near the medial section; the right lobe exhibits lower amplitude, higher frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a strong convex curve toward the distal tip; the right lobe follows a more horizontal and linear trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast heterogeneous pixel clusters (white and brown) detected at the terminal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) present on the lateral tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetrical elevation of the left lobe relative to the water line.
